name: pypy-review-toolkit
description: 11 agents and 6 commands for reviewing PyPy's RPython interpreter core, object space, JIT, and lib_pypy: translated()/untranslated() divergence, JIT immutability-contract auditing, interp/app boundary leak detection, RPython-restriction scanning, scanner-backed JIT structural review, git-history analysis, CFFI/native-resource lifecycle triage, within-class and cross-class guard-consistency triage, GC-hint discipline, coverage mapping (/map), and reachability-weighted exploration (/informed-explore).

commands.name: explore
commands.description: Full phased review: discovery → all scanners → agent triage → synthesis

commands.name: health
commands.description: Quick scored 1–10 dashboard across every review dimension

commands.name: hotspots
commands.description: Rank the riskiest locations by divergence, immutability, and guard gaps

commands.name: known-issues
commands.description: Cross-reference the known-bugs catalogue against a fresh scanner run

commands.name: map
commands.description: Build a coverage map of all scanners, their layers, and known reachability entry points

commands.name: informed-explore
commands.description: Reachability-weighted exploration — same as /explore but prioritises HIGH-reachability findings
